profile.headline: Founder | Software Engineer | Mission-driven and user-focused
profile.summary:
Collaborative, innovative, and thoughtful software engineer with 10+ years of development experience across the entire web stack, leading the delivery of 9+ web applications from 0 to 1. I've led cross-functional teams, founded and built a platform from scratch, and delivered products used by thousands of educators nationwide at the Carnegie Foundation. I leverage AI daily to accelerate development, documentation, and research.

I've primarily worked in education technology, meeting the needs of students, educators, and administrators. In previous roles, I set a high standard for how technology and education can come together to make a measurable difference in teachers' and students' lives, and I played a pivotal role in shaping the organization's technology strategy. I like knowing the work I do makes the world a better place, and thus enjoy software engineering roles in the education, healthcare, biotech, and social justice industries. Additionally, I enjoy talking directly with end users; knowing I'm helping solve their problems is rewarding to me.

I maintain a professional tech blog and am a writer for DevGenius, writing posts on interesting and challenging work, brainstorms, and project postmortems. As far as personal writing, I am currently in the editing stages of a cyberpunk novel that will be part of a trilogy.

Buy me a coffee: buymeacoffee.com/ndequity

positions.title: Founder / Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
* Architected, developed, and deployed a full-stack web platform from 0 to 1 connecting neurodivergent individuals and families to community-certified professionals, sensory-rated spaces, and local organizations, built on Django, Next.js, and PostgreSQL on GCP.
* Expanded test coverage from 3% to 84% on the backend and 95% on the frontend, writing 225 tests across the stack to ensure platform reliability and maintainability. 
* Reduced cloud hosting costs by 25% through infrastructure optimizations on Google Cloud Platform and Cloudflare. 
* Developed a comprehensive operational plan including a five-year strategic roadmap, revenue model, $394,000 Pilot Year budget, and full suite of pitch and fundraising materials.
positions.insights: Skills: Next.js · TypeScript · Tailwind CSS · Django · PostgreSQL

positions.title: AI Model Evaluator
positions.description: * Evaluated and compared AI model outputs across code generation, agent development, and image analysis, providing structured qualitative feedback to improve performance.

positions.title: Integration Developer
positions.description:
* Implemented and maintained over 50 data integration solutions to improve operational efficiency within the university, impacting daily workflows for thousands of students, educators, and staff. Utilized Boomi, Python, Groovy, and Javascript. 
* Created internal documentation, guides, and data dictionaries that reduced team onboarding time by approximately 50%, streamlining credential setup, environment configuration, and service discovery for new staff.
* Wrote custom scripts and internal tools for our team to facilitate data exploration and effective troubleshooting, demonstrating a proactive approach to problem-solving.

company.name: Carnegie Foundation for the Advancement of Teaching

positions.title: Lead Web Developer
positions.description:
* Led and mentored a high-performing multidisciplinary engineering team of 5 to deliver 5 scalable web applications serving hundreds of school districts and thousands of educators and students across the U.S. 
* Reduced cloud hosting costs by 90% on AWS and 30% on GCP through infrastructure analysis, resource tuning, and scheduled Kubernetes node scaling via Cloud Functions and Cloud Scheduler. 
* Deployed an automated data processing pipeline using Google Bigquery and Apache Airflow in Google Kubernetes Engine, running R, Python, and HLM workloads, reducing the workflow from two months to fifteen minutes. 
* Drove alignment across engineering, product, and executive stakeholders—translating technical priorities into business objectives and outcomes, as well as developing informed project roadmaps and delivering projects on time and within scope. 
* Completed thorough code reviews, provided mentorship and coaching to junior engineers, conducted pair programming sessions, and championed engineering best practices across the team. 
* Redesigned team documentation, team processes, norms, and meeting schedules to better align with neurodiverse learning styles, regaining 30% of our work time.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
* Designed, developed, and deployed 4 production web applications, from scratch and at scale, used by hundreds of school districts and thousands of teachers and students. Worked on a multidisciplinary team of 7. 
* Created a survey application ecosystem, end-to-end, allowing teachers to create, schedule, and administer surveys, with a dashboard tracking results over time.
* Developed a student and teacher portal using Ruby and Ruby on Rails that connected our in-house survey tool and the Canvas LMS.
* Utilized the d3.js library for data visualization.
* Managed work using Agile practices. Conducted sprint planning, standups, and retrospective sessions. Wrote user stories. Customized Jira to facilitate both development and design tasks.
* Wrote training manuals and facilitated staff training sessions for our web applications. Wrote multiple blog posts on interesting and challenging work, brainstorms, and project postmortems, several of which have been published in a popular online publication.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
• Streamlined internal processes by creating a PHP backend and MySQL database for staff to use.
• Maintained static and Drupal websites.
• Troubleshooted software and hardware issues on both office computers and servers.

•	Held weekly meetings to discuss progress and update roadmap when necessary

•	Troubleshooted software and hardware issues on both office computers and servers

projects.title: Sketchy Business
projects.description: In Sketchy Business you play a doodle named Biff whose task is to find his family which was torn away from him and placed in the back of the sketchbook. Biff using a creative arsenal of unconventional weapons, must make his way through the sketchbook fighting such enemies as dinosaurs with jetpacks, business suit birds, angry golfers, a giant tyrannosaurus rex, and an evil flying demon. Upgrade Biff for his difficult journey by using the in-game shop to upgrade weapons and armor. Only you can help Biff on his sketchy journey through the sketchbook. It’s going to be some Sketchy Business.

projects.title: Galactic Enforcer
projects.description: Galactic Enforcer is primarily a puzzle game and secondarily a first-person shooter. It is designed with mobile devices (specifically Android and iPhone) in mind. Arcade style gameplay designed to compliment the pick-up-and-play nature of mobile games
